full_prompt_en: The image is a square black-and-white staged photograph of a woman standing close to a plain dark wall. She occupies the center from head to below the waist, leaning slightly and tilting her head toward the right. Her eyes look downward and outward with a composed, tired, or reflective expression. Short textured hair rises above her forehead. She wears a dark dress or wrap with full elbow-length sleeves and a gathered knot at the waist. Both hands appear tucked into pockets or behind the folds of the garment. A large white circular light glows in the upper-left corner, separated from her head by a stretch of dark wall. The light is nearly featureless, like a moonlike disk or round lamp. It creates a gentle halo on the wall behind the upper body, with gray gradually darkening toward the outer edges. Her face and forehead catch brighter side light; the garment remains a deep charcoal mass, with only folds at the collar, sleeves, and waist revealed. Her shadow falls behind and toward the right, merging into the darker wall. No furniture or scenery fills the background. The photographic grain and subtle wall texture are visible, so the dark field is not a digital black. The composition depends on the relationship between the white circle, the smaller illuminated face, and the broad dark shape of the clothing. There is enough empty upper space to make the circle a second visual anchor. The pose is quiet and inward, while the lighting gives it a restrained theatrical quality. The image feels reflective and solemn, using grayscale, sparse geometry, and the natural presence of the woman rather than decorative detail.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形黑白摆拍照片，一位女子紧贴素深色墙站立。她从头到腰下占据中央，身体微倚，头向右倾。眼睛向下、向外看，神情镇定、疲惫或沉思。短而有肌理的头发从额头上竖起。她穿深色连衣裙或裹衣，袖子到肘部且宽松，腰间束成结。双手似乎插在口袋里，或藏在衣褶后。左上角一只大白圆光发亮，与她的头之间隔着一段深墙。光盘几乎没有内部细节，像月亮或圆灯。它在上身后的墙面形成温和光晕，灰色向外缘逐渐变深。她的脸与额头受到较亮侧光；衣服保持深炭色体块，只有领、袖与腰间褶痕显露。影子向后、向右落下，与更深的墙面合并。背景没有家具或风景。摄影颗粒和细微墙面肌理可见，因此深色域不是数字纯黑。构图依靠白圆、较小的受光面孔与衣服宽阔深形之间的关系。上方留有足够空处，使圆光成为第二视觉锚。姿势安静而内向，照明则赋予克制的舞台感。画面沉静庄严，以灰阶、稀疏几何和女子的自然存在取胜，而非装饰细节。
style_prompt_en: Staged black-and-white photography balances one simple luminous disk against a smaller, softly lit human-scale form and broad charcoal mass. A plain wall provides gray falloff, gentle shadow, and almost no contextual detail. Side light reveals a face or focal surface while dark fabric remains mostly solid, with only key folds legible. Fine grain and subtle background texture keep the monochrome tactile. The composition leaves intentional empty space around the bright circular anchor. Gestures are restrained, allowing posture and tonal weight to create emotion. The result is solemn and quietly theatrical, with sparse geometry and graded darkness replacing a busy setting.
style_prompt_zh: 摆拍黑白摄影用一个简洁明亮圆盘平衡较小、柔和受光的人尺度形体和宽阔炭色体块。素墙提供灰阶衰减、温和影子，几乎没有环境细节。侧光显露面孔或焦点表面，深色布料大多保持完整体块，仅关键褶痕可辨。细颗粒与微妙背景肌理让单色可触。构图在亮圆锚点周围有意留下空处。手势克制，让姿态与调子重量生出情绪。效果庄严而安静地富于舞台感，以稀疏几何和层次化黑暗代替繁忙场景。
theme_en: A woman in dark clothing beneath a bright circular light
theme_zh: 一位身穿深色衣服的女子立于明亮圆光下
name: Carrie Mae Weems
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
